The gate agent brought up a detail about supply orders after a hurried exchange, and I opened this report to record the matter in a clear and respectful way. Incident Report: Misrouted Pet Supply Notice at Aurelia Skyways.

During the outbound check-in flow at the Companion Animal Travel Desk, a traveler arrived with a companion animal carrier and asked for help after noticing that the associated supply order had not been staged with the rest of the pet items. The discussion took place beside the acceptance counter, where the carrier was already under observation and the pet was calm. The gate agent had heard the concern while coordinating boarding support and passed the matter to our desk before departure handling began. The traveler remained cooperative, and the animal showed no signs of distress.

<<FACT F118>> I confirmed the missing order detail with the ground team and reviewed the handoff notes for the carrier. The issue appeared to stem from a crossed supply tag during a busy transfer between service points, not from any unsafe handling of the animal. Because our standard is to keep each journey steady and humane, I asked for the nearby reserve supplies to be checked, and I guided the traveler through the available options in simple terms. The carrier was kept in a quiet position while the team completed the review.

I then informed the operations lead, logged the discrepancy, and arranged for the proper supplies to be matched to the traveler before onward movement. The ground team corrected the staging area and confirmed that no other pet items were affected. I also reminded the staff involved to verify labels against the manifest before release, especially when several companion animal cases are moving through the same channel.

Follow-up will include a brief refresher for the desk and ramp staff on cross-checking supply orders and on reporting a mismatch as soon as it is seen. The traveler was reassured that the matter was handled and that Aurelia Skyways remains committed to careful, humane service. The report is closed with the note that the animal traveled without incident after the correction was made.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
